test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
A student has 5 subjects in an examination. The distribution of hard work of 16 hours a day over 5 subjects and marks obtained 400 out of 500 are shown in the charts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7199b04049d2c4fa8826be2a0e4e22508d1039abe62a63fc767f3ba3531dfd9.png] 

 

How much time did the student spend on Math and how much marks were obtained in math?
solution:
**Given:**

The student worked for 16 hours a day over 5 subjects, and the total marks obtained are 400 out of 500.

The distribution of time spent and marks obtained are shown in the pie charts.

Time spent on Math = 40% of 16 hours

Marks obtained in Math = 21% of 400 marks

**Formula used:**

Time spent on Math = (Percentage of time spent on Math) × (Total time in hours)

Marks obtained in Math = (Percentage of marks in Math) × (Total marks obtained)

**Calculation:**

For time spent on Math:

⇒ Time spent = 40% × 16 hours

⇒ Time spent = (40/100) × 16

⇒ Time spent = 6.4 hours

For marks obtained in Math:

⇒ Marks obtained = 21% × 400 marks

⇒ Marks obtained = (21/100) × 400

⇒ Marks obtained = 84 marks

**∴ The student spent 6.4 hours on Math and obtained 84 marks in Math.**
